name: Imploding Kittens: Expansion
players: base-game range; up to 6 with an Original 56-card deck
components: requires an Exploding Kittens base deck
inventory_definition: Box contents, before removing unused cards or dealing. Cat identities are distinct types; artwork variants do not add types or copies.

cards.name: Alter the Future 3x
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Privately inspect and reorder the top three draw-pile cards, return them face down, and continue your turn. Do not show them to others.

cards.name: Draw From the Bottom
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Finish one turn by drawing the bottom card instead of the top. Resolve that card normally. Under an Attack, this satisfies only one of the required turns.

cards.name: Feral Cat
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: A wildcard for powerless cat cards in matching cat combos. It cannot stand in for a non-cat action card such as Attack or Shuffle.

cards.name: Imploding Kitten
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: If drawn face down, secretly reinsert it face up anywhere in the draw pile without spending a Defuse. Drawing it face up kills you immediately: neither Defuse nor Nope can save you. In the expansion PDF, discard it after it kills a player. It has a visible white border when face up. A Streaking Kitten cannot protect you from it. Shuffle face-up Imploding cards out of sight.

cards.name: Reverse
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: Reverse play direction and end one turn without drawing. With two players it acts as Skip. During an Attack it reverses direction but only satisfies one required turn. Update the Cone of Shame's direction arrow if it is being used.

cards.name: Targeted Attack 2x
cards.artwork_mapping: shared family candidates; edition print not established
cards.rule: End your current turn(s) without drawing and choose another player to take two turns; play continues from that victim. If responding to an Attack, transfer all untaken turns and add two. Does not require targeting your immediate neighbor.
